lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct high-contrast vertical white lines traversing the lateral torso. Spacing is predominantly uniform with a slight increase in inter-line distance towards the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Topological bifurcation observed on the 3rd line from the anterior, splitting in the upper third of the torso. A minor Y-shaped split is visible at the ventral termination of the 10th line.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first anterior line is abbreviated, terminating in the upper third of the torso height. The 11th line is a short segment localized to the dorsal-posterior region.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Cluster of 3 distinct high-contrast spots located on the lower haunch, centered above the hock joint. Additional isolated spot present on the mid-posterior flank.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the lateral haunch align on a horizontal axis with a larger spot on the posterior flank.

other_distinctive_markers: Pink tongue is visibly extended and contacting the upper muzzle. Two prominent white spots are located on the lower cheek. White horizontal bands are present on the mid-section of all four limbs.
